events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the day music icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur on the anniversary of his passing. His music and message continue to resonate, shaping hip-hop and culture for decades.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Influence
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His innovative guitar work redefined rock music forever.

events.title: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks – pure timeless magic.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce rock 'n' roll spirit continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger after all these years. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. Its powerful message of peace and unity remains as relevant as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of James Bond, marking the anniversary of the first film's premiere.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the incomparable John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable.

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. Its experimental sound and diverse tracks still captivate listeners today.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the one and only Freddie Mercury. A true showman whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, pushing boundaries and influencing countless artists. A truly pivotal album.

events.title: John Lennon's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this solemn anniversary, we remember John Lennon. His music and vision continue to inspire dreams of a better world.
